basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Madurai Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 36 Posts
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Madurai, Tamil Nadu, under the PMSSY Division of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, invites applications for 36 posts of Junior Resident (Non-Academic) on a temporary basis for 1 year, at Pay Level 10 (56100 – 177500) of the 7th CPC plus usual allowances including NPA (if applicable). Applications are made through a Google Form, which opened on 13 November 2026 and closes on 3 December 2026 at 5.00 PM. Selection is on merit assessed through interview.

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay Level 10 (56100 – 177500) of 7th CPC plus usual allowances including NPA (if applicable)

how_to_apply: Fill the Google Form at https://forms.gle/8CqCB5iXLhHmUN519. The form opened on 13 November 2026 and closes on 3 December 2026 at 5.00 PM.
Do not send a hard copy of the application at this stage.
If more than one application is submitted, only the latest one is considered. Earlier ones are not scrutinised.

Candidates declared eligible report at AIIMS Madurai on the date of written test / interview with the filled application form (given as Annexure), one set of self-attested photocopies and two passport size photographs.
Original certificates, as listed under Documents Required, are verified before the written test / interview.

Reporting, document verification and screening, and the written test / interview have no date or time yet; the schedule says they will be intimated later. The venue is Project Cell Office, AIIMS Madurai, Government TB Hospital Campus, Austinpatti Post, Madurai, Tamil Nadu. Any change of venue will be intimated later.

The Screening Committee screens the submitted documents before the interview, and only candidates it declares eligible are allowed for interview. Selection is on the basis of merit assessed through interview. If the number of candidates is more, a written test is conducted. The decision of the Executive Director, AIIMS Madurai is final and binding. Merely attending the interview does not guarantee selection.

The fee is paid through SBI Collect only; cheque, MO, IPO, CRF, cash, demand draft and similar modes are not accepted, and such applications are treated as without fee and summarily rejected. The notice gives no separate fee deadline. Steps given in the notice:
Open the SBI Collect link printed in the notice: https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/icollecthome.htm?corpID=6691826
Search "ALL INDIA INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES, MADURAI" and click it.
Select "Recruitment Cell - Application Fee" from the drop down menu and fill the details. Columns marked "*" are mandatory.
Pay by SBI Net Banking, other Banks Net Banking, Credit Card, Debit Card or other payment modes. Transaction charges are borne by the applicant.
Take a print out of the payment receipt and attach it with the application form. Enter the transaction ID / reference number, date and amount in the application.

Candidates claiming fee exemption must mention "Fee Exempted" in the fee details space of the application form. Fee once paid is not refunded or adjusted under any circumstances, and applications without the full prescribed fee are summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: AIIMS Madurai is a healthcare Institute of National Importance, established by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojna (PMSSY). Its letterhead names JIPMER, Puducherry as the Mentor Institute. Applications are invited by the Executive Director, AIIMS Madurai. The notice says the post will be rolled over for walk in interview, if not filled.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 36 vacancies for one post, with the following category-wise break-up (16 + 9 + 5 + 2 + 4 = 36). 4% reservation for PwBD on a horizontal basis applies as per Government Rules. Vacancies may increase or decrease at the time of selection. The numbers are provisional and subject to change without any notice. If no application is received under the EWS category, the post may be filled under the UR category. Reservation for ST / SC / OBC / EWS / PwBD candidates is as per Central Govt. Rules.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Only candidates declared successful in the qualifying degree exam, who will be completing their tenure for it on or before the closing date of application, are eligible. If the result of the qualifying degree exam is declared after the closing date of application, the candidature stands cancelled and no claim for selection on the basis of interview is considered. The date for determining eligibility for age, educational qualification and experience is the closing date of the online application. Candidates who have already done three (3) terms of Junior Residency anywhere will not be considered. A term is 1 year; if someone joins and leaves at any time, it counts as one term irrespective of the duration of work. MCI / State Medical Council Registration is mandatory before joining, if selected. The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law. Candidates working in Government / Semi-Government / PSU must submit a No Objection Certificate from the present employer. In-service candidates are not permitted for interview without it. The notice prints no experience requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post. The upper age limit as on the closing date of application is 33 years. Candidates of SC / ST / OBC / EWS / PwBD must submit the valid certificate in the requisite proforma issued by the authority concerned. *Relaxation for Government servants is admissible only to employees working under the Central Government, not under an Autonomous Body / State Government / PSU, and working in posts in the same line or allied cadres where the service already rendered is useful for the post advertised. The decision rests with the authority of AIIMS Madurai.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay is Pay Level 10 (56100 – 177500) of the 7th CPC plus usual allowances including NPA (if applicable). The appointment is purely temporary and initially for 1 year. It gives no right to regular appointment or permanent absorption in the Institute. The contract expires automatically after 1 year (1 term) unless renewed for another term, up to a maximum of 3 terms, on the recommendation of the concerned HoD and if the service is required by the Institute. The Institute can terminate the appointment at any time without assigning any reason. The employee can leave by giving 01 (one) month notice or salary in lieu thereof. A candidate cannot resign or leave within 03 months from the date of joining. The initial place of posting is the temporary campus of AIIMS Madurai, i.e. Government Medical College, Madurai, Tamil Nadu. It will be shifted to the permanent campus based on the progress of construction. The appointment is full-time and private practice of any kind is prohibited. Leave entitlement follows the Institute's leave rules as amended from time to time. No travelling or other allowances are paid for joining the post. The appointee is not entitled to Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion or other benefits of regular Government servants. The posts are regulated under the Central Residency Scheme and governed by CCS (Temporary Service) Rules.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Madurai Junior Resident (Non-Academic) Job Description
content_sections.text: Work in shifts and be posted on rotation at any place, including Trauma & Emergency Medicine, Casualty, Ward, OPD, and camps organised by the Institute, Government or the concerned department. May be posted as casualty medical officer on any day, as per requirement and rotation, to conduct casualty admission. May be responsible for medico legal examination and reporting. May be posted in the rural health and urban centres attached to the Institute for a period decided by the Institute. Perform the duties assigned; the competent authority may assign any duty as required, with no extra allowances for such assignment. Conform to the rules of conduct and discipline applicable to Institute employees.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Originals, together with the filled application form and one set of self-attested photocopies, are to be brought at the time of interview, arranged in this order: Identity Proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter Card, Aadhar Card) Address Proof (Passport, Driving License, Voter Card, Aadhar Card) Certificate showing Date of Birth (10th Certificate / Birth Certificate) Two recent passport size photographs Class SSC / 10th & 12th Certificates MBBS Mark Sheets & Certificates Internship Completion Certificate FMGE Certificate conducted by NBE (for Foreign Graduate) Registration with MCI / State Medical Council Experience Certificate (copy of completion of Internship) Reservation category Certificate (OBC*/SC/ST/PwD/EWS); *OBC candidates should belong to the non-creamy layer of the Central List of OBC PwBD certificate issued by a duly constituted Medical Board of State or Central Government Hospitals A copy of the certificate issued by the competent authority for every claim of reservation, fee exemption or age relaxation Self-declaration for the number of terms under the Residency Scheme so far

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Resident (Non-Academic) vacancies are there at AIIMS Madurai?
faq.answer: There are 36 vacancies: 16 UR, 9 OBC, 5 SC, 2 ST and 4 EWS. The numbers are provisional and may increase or decrease at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 3 December 2026 at 5.00 PM. It opened on 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for AIIMS Madurai Junior Resident?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed MBBS (including completion of Internship) or an equivalent degree recognized by MCI / NMC. The result must be declared on or before the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 33 years as on the closing date of application. Relaxation is 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC / ST, and 5 years for PwBD and Government servants, as per the notice's table.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: UR / OBC / EWS candidates pay ₹ 500 plus transaction charges through SBI Collect. SC / ST / PwBD and women candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the Google Form at https://forms.gle/8CqCB5iXLhHmUN519 by 3 December 2026, 5.00 PM. Do not send a hard copy now; eligible candidates bring the filled form and documents when they report for the interview.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is on merit assessed through interview, after the Screening Committee checks documents. A written test is conducted if the number of candidates is more.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary of a Junior Resident at AIIMS Madurai?
faq.answer: Pay is Pay Level 10 (56100 – 177500) of the 7th CPC plus usual allowances including NPA (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is temporary for an initial 1 year and gives no right to regular appointment. It may be renewed up to a maximum of 3 terms if the Institute requires the service.

faq.question: Q10. Who cannot be considered for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates who have already done three (3) terms of Junior Residency anywhere will not be considered. In-service Government / Semi-Government / PSU candidates cannot be interviewed without a No Objection Certificate from their employer.
